purpose: Bounded load + correctness mix for scripts/load-test.sh: synthetic discovery/publication/offering/contact workload with restriction, expiry, and idempotency exercised during load. Never sends real verification or WhatsApp messages (deterministic fake provider, disposable database).

quotas_respected.note: Stays inside free-plan allowances so load successes are 2xx: at most 3 open demands and 6 activations per buyer, at most 10 offer submissions per seller.

pass_predicate.note: HTTP 5xx, network errors, and timeouts fail the run. Expected business refusals (duplicate, expired, quota) must carry non-5xx codes and are tallied separately. No duplicate contact rows, no leaked destination outside buyer handoffs, no quota overflow.
